entries.name: Caleb Williams
entries.summary: Bears head coach Ben Johnson was non-committal on a return date for Williams (hamstring) after Sunday's 31-7 loss to the Packers, Chris Emma of 670TheScore.com reports. "He's on track. We'll see if that's Atlanta [in Week 6] or after," Johnson said. "I think it's going to be close."

entries.summary: out

entries.summary: out

entries.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
entries.summary: Samuel is expected to miss at least a couple weeks due to a hamstring injury he sustained during the 49ers' 32-29 win over the Seahawks on Sunday, David Lombardi of the San Francisco Standard reports.

entries.name: DeVonta Smith
entries.summary: Head coach Nick Sirianni expressed hope Monday that Smith (hamstring) would return for this Sunday's game against the Panthers, Zach Berman of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Hollywood Brown
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Jalen Nailor
entries.summary: Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak said Monday that Nailor (concussion) is expected to practice this week, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Jordan Addison
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Joshua Palmer
entries.summary: Palmer (shoulder) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Rams, Katherine Fitzgerald of The Buffalo News reports.

entries.name: Justin Joly
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Kyle Monangai
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Lamar Jackson
entries.summary: Head coach Jesse Minter said Monday that Jackson is "definitely doing better" in his recovery from a sprained left ankle, Jamison Hensley of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Marcus Mariota
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Quentin Johnston
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Rico Dowdle
entries.summary: Steelers offensive coordinator Brian Angelichio said Monday that he anticipates Dowdle (toe) returning to action Week 6 against the Buccaneers, Mike DeFabo of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Roman Wilson
entries.summary: Head coach Mike McCarthy said Monday that Wilson (finger) will not play against the Buccaneers on Sunday, Nick Farabaugh of SteelersNow.com reports.

entries.name: Saquon Barkley
entries.summary: Head coach Nick Sirianni said Monday that he's "hopeful" that both Barkley (hamstring) and DeVonta Smith (hamstring) will both be cleared to play against the Panthers on Sunday, Zach Berman of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Stefon Diggs
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Tom Kennedy
entries.summary: Kennedy suffered a season-ending MCL injury in his right knee during the Lions' 45-21 win over the Cardinals on Sunday, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Tylan Wallace
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Zach Charbonnet
entries.summary: The Seahawks listed Charbonnet (knee) as a limited participant on Monday's practice estimate, Bob Condotta of The Seattle Times reports.

entries.name: David Montgomery
entries.summary: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that Montgomery (groin) is considered week-to-week, Jonathan M. Alexander of the Houston Chronicle reports.

entries.name: Will Shipley
entries.summary: Shipley (foot) was diagnosed with a partial tear of his plantar fascia after exiting Sunday's 19-17 loss to the Jaguars in London and could be sidelined multiple weeks, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: CeeDee Lamb
entries.summary: Lamb is believed to be dealing with a "quad bruise" that is "not considered to be serious," Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: DJ Moore
entries.summary: Moore (shoulder) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Rams, Katherine Fitzgerald of The Buffalo News reports.

entries.name: Drew Lock
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Jalen Coker
entries.summary: Head coach Dave Canales said Monday that Coker is "on track" to return from a one-game absence against the Eagles on Sunday, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Jaxon Smith-Njigba
entries.summary: Smith-Njigba was estimated as a limited practice participant Monday due to an ankle injury, Bob Condotta of The Seattle Times reports.

entries.name: KC Concepcion
entries.summary: Concepcion has entered the NFL's concussion protocol, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reported Sunday.

entries.name: Kenyon Sadiq
entries.summary: Sadiq won't return to Sunday's game versus the Browns due to a concussion.

entries.name: Ladd McConkey
entries.summary: McConkey (foot) was active but didn't play any snaps in Sunday's 23-17 loss to the Broncos.

entries.name: Michael Penix Jr.
entries.summary: The Falcons have optimism that Penix's rib injury isn't overly serious and that he'll be available to play Sunday against the Bears, Jonathan Jones and Josh Kendall of The Athletic report.

entries.name: Quinshon Judkins
entries.summary: Browns head coach Todd Monken said that Judkins is considered day-to-day after sustaining a "tweak" to his ankle in Sunday's 17-12 loss to the Jets, and the running back hasn't been ruled out for a Week 6 game against the Ravens, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Raheim Sanders
entries.summary: Sanders (hip) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Jets.

entries.name: Rashee Rice
entries.summary: Rice (hamstring) is believed to have sustained a "relatively minor" injury in Sunday's win over the Raiders and could be ready to play following the Chiefs' Week 5 bye, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Skyy Moore
entries.summary: The Packers ruled out Moore (ankle) for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Bears.

entries.name: T.J. Hockenson
entries.summary: The Vikings downgraded Hockenson to out for Sunday's game against the Saints due to a concussion.

entries.name: Tanner Hudson
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Tre' Harris
entries.summary: Harris (hamstring) is questionable to return to Sunday's contest against the Broncos.

entries.name: TreVeyon Henderson
entries.summary: Henderson (ankle) is slated to undergo further medical testing Monday after exiting Sunday's 45-17 win over the Raiders, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: A.J. Brown
entries.summary: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that Brown (ankle) has "a chance" to return to practice this week, Mark Daniels of MassLive.com reports.

entries.name: Braxton Berrios
entries.summary: The Giants placed Berrios (foot) on their injured reserve list Wednesday, Dan Salomone of the Giants' official site reports.

entries.name: Chris Brooks
entries.summary: The Packers placed Brooks (ankle) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Dillon Gabriel
entries.summary: Gabriel (back) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Jets, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.
entries.summary: Thornton (hamstring) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Patriots, Paul Gutierrez of Raiders.com reports.

entries.name: Durham Smythe
entries.summary: The Ravens placed Smythe (Achilles) on their injured reserve list Wednesday, Ryan Mink of the Ravens' official site reports.

entries.name: Dylan Sampson
entries.summary: Head coach Todd Monken said Monday that there is a "possibility" that the Browns open the 21-day practice window for Sampson (knee) this week, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Hunter Long
entries.summary: The Cardinals placed Long (knee) on injured reserve Tuesday.

entries.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
entries.summary: Head coach Jesse Minter said Monday that the Ravens could designate Lane (wrist) to return from injured reserve as soon as Wednesday, Jonas Shaffer of the Baltimore Banner reports.

entries.name: Jaylin Lane
entries.summary: The Commanders placed Lane (ankle) on injured reserve Tuesday.

entries.name: Jeremy McNichols
entries.summary: McNichols (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Giants.

entries.name: Jordyn Tyson
entries.summary: Saints head coach Kellen Moore said Monday that Tyson (hamstring) is "progressing well" but isn't on track to return to practice this week, Jeff Nowak reports.

entries.name: Josh Oliver
entries.summary: The Vikings placed Oliver (biceps) on injured reserve Tuesday, Craig Peters of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
entries.summary: The Steelers placed Pittman (foot) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Pat Bryant
entries.summary: Bryant (ankle) was placed on the Broncos' injured reserve Friday.

entries.name: Savion Williams
entries.summary: Williams (ankle) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bears, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

entries.name: Terrance Ferguson
entries.summary: Ferguson (ankle) is expected to be ready to return after his four-game stint on injured reserve, Cameron DaSilva of USA Today reports.

entries.name: Trevor Etienne
entries.summary: Head coach Dave Canales said Etienne (ankle) will "for sure" be back following the Panthers' Week 5 bye, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Trey Lance
entries.summary: The Chargers placed Lance (groin) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Tyquan Thornton
entries.summary: The Chiefs placed Thornton (ankle) on injured reserve Monday, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Will Mallory
entries.summary: Mallory (thumb) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Steelers.

entries.name: Xavier Legette
entries.summary: The Panthers placed Legette (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Darin Gantt of the team's official site reports.
